text: {"features":[{"evidence":"\"Software Engnieer\" and other visible typos","name":"Surface polish","description":"This captures how cleanly the letter is written at the sentence level, especially spelling and proofreading quality.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frequent distracting errors make the letter feel careless or hard to trust."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Several noticeable errors interrupt the flow, though the content remains understandable."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mostly clean, with only minor slips that do not meaningfully distract."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Polished and reason for wanting this role beyond general interest in a job."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows broad interest in security or backend work, but the rationale could fit many roles."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives a specific and relevant reason for wanting this role, tied to prior experience or values."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents a compelling, personal, and secure defaults, infrastructure, or automation, but only broadly."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Accurately references several core parts of the role such as vulnerability handling, lifecycle security, impact, or bounded AI agents."}]},{"evidence":"\"help busy developer teams do the secure thing by default\"","name":"Internal customer empathy","description":"This captures whether the letter frames security tooling as a service to developer teams, with attention to reducing friction and making secure behavior easier.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not discuss developer teams as users or beneficiaries of the work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows general interest in helping others, but without a clear internal-customer framing."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly emphasizes making reduction."}]},{"evidence":"\"work alongside dedicated security engineers and absorb the craft\"","name":"Collaboration posture","description":"This captures how explicitly the applicant presents themselves as someone who will partner closely with security specialists and build through feedback from others.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Presents the work as largely individual and shows no clear collaboration posture."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Uses generic teamwork language without showing how collaboration would matter in this role."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explicitly mentions partnering with security engineers or building in close contact with users of the tooling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Makes collaboration central, emphasizing learning from specialists, serving internal users, and iterating through proximity and feedback."}]},{"evidence":"\"turned a brute-force correlation job into a streaming computation\"","name":"Evidence concreteness","description":"This strengths without concrete examples."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes a few examples, but they remain vague about what was built or changed."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Uses several concrete examples of systems, tasks, or technical decisions to support its claims."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is consistently specific, making major claims easy to trust through concrete architectures, projects, or outcomes."}]},{"evidence":"\"Bachelor's degree\" versus \"Master's degree\" versus \"Doctoral degree\"","name":"Academic credential level","description":"This captures the level of formal academic preparation the letter claims in a relevant technical field.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No relevant degree is stated, or the academic background is unclear."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States a relevant bachelor's degree."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States a relevant master's degree."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"States a relevant doctoral degree."}]},{"evidence":"\"3 years\" versus \"5 years\" versus \"7 years\"","name":"Relevant experience duration","description":"This captures the amount of directly relevant professional software relevant experience."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid mid-level tenure, around 4 to 5 years."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows extensive tenure, typically 6 or more years."}]},{"evidence":"\"launching 2 production services\" versus \"6 production services\"","name":"Production delivery record","description":"This captures the breadth of real production software maintenance."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows limited but credible production ownership, such as 1 to 2 services."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows repeated production ownership across several services, such as 3 to 4."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows extensive production delivery across many services, typically 5 or more."}]},{"evidence":"\"Python is all over my recent systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python, or mentions it so vaguely that depth is unclear."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions some Python use, but without showing substantial reliance or ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows strong day-to-day Python use for services, tooling, automation, or analysis."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows production-grade Python ownership across multiple contexts, often with evidence that other engineers depend on the resulting systems."}]},{"evidence":"\"shipping language-model-backed capabilities\"","name":"AI meaningful AI experience is presented."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows interest in AI or light exposure, but not real production use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly states that the applicant automation, but without a clear agent architecture."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes a concrete agentic design, typically pairing Python agents with Go back-end infrastructure."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows thoughtful agent governance, such as bounded actions, permissions, auditability, explicit constraints, or carefully managed autonomy."}]},{"evidence":"\"turned a manual report queue into a classified, routed pipeline\"","name":"Vulnerability triage automation","description":"This captures experience automating the intake, presented."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in automating security toil, but without direct evidence of having done it."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows concrete experience building triage or routing automation for vulnerability reports."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong end-to-end ownership of a vulnerability-handling pipeline, often with deduplication, classification, routing, or clear workload reduction."}]},{"evidence":"\"threat models and follow-through\"","name":"Security assessment practice","description":"This captures whether the letter shows hands-on experience evaluating systems for security risk rather than only building software near security topics.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No security assessment experience is modeling, code review, finding classes, or remediation verification."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial assessment practice across designs or services, with a clear builder's-eye approach and attention to follow-through."}]},{"evidence":"\"replaced ad-hoc traversals with proper graph algorithms\"","name":"Algorithmic fluency","description":"This captures how convincingly the letter algorithms."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents a standout example where algorithmic choices materially changed tractability, performance, or system behavior."}]},{"evidence":"\"maintainer of an actively used open-source project\"","name":"Open-source ownership","description":"This captures how much the letter shows public engineering stewardship through upstream fixes, maintenance, or fixes."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular contribution or maintenance of a smaller project."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows meaningful maintainer responsibility for a used project, including sustained ownership."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows an ambitious infrastructure or distributed-systems project chosen specifically to tackle hard technical problems."}]},{"evidence":"\"placed near offensive practice through sustained high-level participation or notable competition results."}]},{"evidence":"\"CompTIA Security+\" versus \"OSCP\"","name":"Security mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Presents a foundational certification such as Security+."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents a hands-on advanced certification such as OSCP or an equivalent
